apps.localizedDescription: Standalone 1-slot companion for Apple TV: install once from Windows/macOS via USB, then self-sign & auto-refresh directly on iPhone via LocalDevVPN (10.7.0.1). Includes ultra-low-latency Apple TV Remote, LiveContainerTV (:8228) multi-app vault, curated & custom tvOS App Library, verified SHA-256 OTA self-updates, and wireless sideloading.

versions.localizedDescription:
4AppleTV-S v1.1.0 (Build 3):
• Added wireless Apple TV screenshot capture (crisp 4K/1080p PNG) with an in-app Screenshots Gallery & export.
• Added ~2-second fast misagent profile renewal (no .ipa reinstall needed) for both Apple TV apps and 4AppleTV-S itself on iPhone, plus automatic TV re-pair orphan healing.
• Added automatic background update check, SHA-256 verified pre-download, and 0-click/1-tap in-place self-update via VPN 10.7.0.1 — one-time USB setup only.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: 4AppleTV-S discovers, controls, launches apps, and installs (.ipa) apps wirelessly on Apple TVs on your local Wi-Fi network and loopback VPN.
